name: emberdeep
description: EMBERDEEP - an endless Zelda-style roguelike descent (HTML5 canvas, vanilla JS). Plays on desktop, phone and tablet.

paragraphs: A Zelda-style, room-by-room dungeon crawler that never ends. Procedural floors, locked doors and colour-coded keys, bosses that return as ever-larger tiers, MEGA bosses with multi-part bodies every 5th floor, and — since the updates — thirteen worlds (one of them hidden) joined by branching routes with hidden, differently-unlocked doors, a boss line for every land, 11 classes, 116 relics, event encounters, companions, Pacts of Heat and a permanent Hearth. Built with plain HTML5 Canvas + vanilla JavaScript — no frameworks, no external assets, no build step. Every sprite is a coloured shape;…
It ships as v1 plus twenty-seven switchable updates (v2–v28) — see Versions.

"which locks are open" starting with nothing, and requires that the floor can be finished from every reachable state (not just one lucky order — keys are fungible, so a player may spend one on the wrong door). A key behind its own lock, behind a lock that needs it, in an unreachable room, or an order-dependent trap fails and the floor is re-wired / regenerated.
